violations.why: ISR overwrites the loop variable between the init and the loop condition check.
The condition is checked, then the ISR changes the index, so the array index at line 32 differs from the checked value.
The ISR writes between the index use and the increment, so the increment overwrites the ISR's value.
The ISR overwrites the incremented value before the loop condition reads it.
The increment is a non-atomic read-modify-write, so the ISR's write is lost.
The ISR overwrites the initial value before the array index read.
